title: WORKSHEET 2
subject: Present Simple, Present Continuous
subjectVi: Ngữ pháp bài 2: Present Simple, Present Continuous

sections.instruction: Read the paragraph and answer the questions:
sections.contextText:
Brian is a doctor. He looks after sick people. He usually gets up at 6.00 o'clock. Today he is late, it is 6.30 and he is still in bed. He usually goes to work by train but today he is driving to work. He arrives at work at 6.30 every morning but it is 7.30 now and he is still driving.
It's 12.00 o'clock now. He always has his lunch at 12.00 but today he isn't having lunch at 12.00, he is looking after his sick patients. It is half past seven now, Brian is watching TV. He usually watches TV at half past seven because his favorite programme starts at half past seven. Brian has his dinner at 8.30 every day and he is having dinner now.
It is 24.00 now. Brian is going to bed. He always goes to bed at 24.00.

questions.prompt: What does Brian do?
acceptedAnswers: He is a doctor.
Brian is a doctor.
He is a doctor. He looks after sick people.
questions.explanation: What does he do? = What is his job?

questions.prompt: What time does he usually get up?
acceptedAnswers: He usually gets up at 6.00 o'clock.
He usually gets up at 6.00.
He usually gets up at six o'clock.
He usually gets up at 6 o'clock.
questions.explanation: present simple for habits: he gets up

questions.prompt: How does he usually go to work?
acceptedAnswers: He usually goes to work by train.
He goes to work by train.
By train.

questions.prompt: Why is he driving to work today?
acceptedAnswers: Because he is late.
Because he is late today.
He is driving to work because he is late.

questions.prompt: What time does he arrive at work every day?
acceptedAnswers: He arrives at work at 6.30.
He arrives at work at 6.30 every morning.
He arrives at work at half past six.
questions.explanation: He arrives at work at 6.30 every morning.

questions.prompt: When does he always have his lunch?
acceptedAnswers: He always has his lunch at 12.00.
He always has his lunch at 12 o'clock.
He always has his lunch at twelve o'clock.

questions.prompt: What is he doing at 12.00 today?
acceptedAnswers: He is looking after his sick patients.
He is looking after sick patients.
He is looking after his patients.

questions.prompt: Why does he usually watch TV at 7.30?
acceptedAnswers: Because his favorite programme starts at half past seven.
Because his favorite programme starts at 7.30.
Because his favourite programme starts at half past seven.
Because his favourite programme starts at 7.30.

questions.prompt: What time does he go to bed?
acceptedAnswers: He goes to bed at 24.00.
He always goes to bed at 24.00.
He goes to bed at midnight.
He always goes to bed at midnight.
questions.explanation: He always goes to bed at 24.00.

questions.prompt: What time is he going to bed now?
acceptedAnswers: He is going to bed at 24.00.
He is going to bed at midnight.
It is 24.00 now.
questions.explanation: It is 24.00 now and he is going to bed.

sections.instruction: Read the questions & answers about ALAN and ask and answer about JUDITH. Write the question and the answer.
sections.contextText:
ALAN
1. What does Alan do? — Alan's a lorry driver.
2. How old is Alan? — He's twenty-five years old.
3. How many days a week does he work? — He works five days a week.
4. What time does he get up? — He gets up at six o'clock every day.
5. What does he eat for breakfast? — He eats an enormous breakfast.
6. What does he drink? — He drinks two cups of tea.
7. What does he do after breakfast? — Then he kisses his wife.
8. What time does he leave for work? — He leaves for work at half past six.
9. Where does he have lunch? — He has lunch in a transport café.
10. What time does he come home? — He comes home at five o'clock.
11. Where does he go in the evening? — In the evening he goes to the pub.
12. What time does he go to bed? — He goes to bed at ten o'clock.

sections.instruction: Read the text carefully and answer the questions:
sections.contextText: Right now I am looking at a picture of Barbara. She is not at home in the picture. She is at the park. She is sitting on a bench. She is eating her lunch. Some boys and girls are running on a path in the park. A squirrel is sitting on the ground in front of Barbara. The squirrel is eating a nut. Barbara is watching the squirrel. She always watches squirrels when she eats her lunch in the park. Some ducks are swimming in the pond in the picture, and some birds are flying in the sky. A policeman is riding a horse. He rides a horse in the park every day. Near Barbara, a family is having a picnic. They go on a picnic every week.

questions.prompt: Where is Barbara in the picture?
acceptedAnswers: She is at the park.
She is in the park.
Barbara is at the park.
She is at the park. She is sitting on a bench.

questions.prompt: What is she doing?
acceptedAnswers: She is eating her lunch.
She is sitting on a bench and eating her lunch.
She is sitting on a bench. She is eating her lunch.
She is watching the squirrel.

questions.prompt: What is the squirrel doing in the picture?
acceptedAnswers: It is eating a nut.
The squirrel is eating a nut.
questions.explanation: The squirrel is eating a nut.

questions.prompt: What does Barbara always do when she has lunch in the park?
acceptedAnswers: She always watches squirrels.
She watches squirrels.
She always watches squirrels when she eats her lunch in the park.
Barbara always watches squirrels.

questions.prompt: What are the ducks doing?
acceptedAnswers: They are swimming in the pond.
The ducks are swimming in the pond.
They are swimming.

questions.prompt: How often does the policeman ride his horse?
acceptedAnswers: He rides his horse every day.
He rides a horse in the park every day.
Every day.
He rides a horse every day.
questions.explanation: He rides a horse in the park every day.

questions.prompt: How often does the family have a picnic at the park?
acceptedAnswers: They go on a picnic every week.
They have a picnic every week.
Every week.
They have a picnic at the park every week.
questions.explanation: They go on a picnic every week.
